transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

Hello, doctor. I feel like I’ve lost the drive and interest in everything I used to care about, even my students and the arts stuff I loved. It's just really hard to find the motivation to do anything anymore.
How long have you been feeling this way? Has it been going on for at least two weeks or longer?

Oh, it's been much longer than two weeks. This loss of drive has actually been building for a little over a year now, probably about 14 months. It all seemed to start around the time the new standardized curriculum was rolled out at my school.
Have there been any periods during this last year when you felt completely back to your usual self, even for a few days or weeks?

No, there haven't been any breaks at all. It's just been a steady, gradual decline over this past year and a half. Ever since that new curriculum started, the loss of drive has just kept building without any relief.
During this time, have you ever had days where your mood lifted noticeably, even if just for a few hours, or has it been consistently low?
No, I haven't experienced my mood lifting or had any "up" days at all. It has just felt consistently flat and empty, and I'm always lacking that drive rather than having any ups and downs.
Have you completely lost interest or pleasure in all activities, or are there still a few things, even small ones, that you find somewhat enjoyable or satisfying?

I’ve completely lost interest in everything, and that spark is just entirely gone. Now, I just go through the motions at work and come home to sit on the couch, not caring enough to start any activities. There really isn't anything I find enjoyable anymore.
Have you also noticed changes in your sleep, appetite, or energy levels during this time?
I haven't noticed any major changes in my sleep or appetite. However, my energy levels have felt extremely low, and it feels like I just have absolutely no drive to do anything at all.
